notes: Key fix: both linear regimes actually use `floor(x)` (rounding down), not raw `x`. This explains E6's constant 4.2 for x in (-5.4..-5.1) and the -302.4 at x=18.7/18.9. I also moved the positive boundary to x>18.5 (E6: 18.5 flat, 18.7 linear) and the negative boundary to x≤-5.1 (E6: -5.1 linear, -5.05 flat).
